facts.fact: Elderline is the National Helpline for Senior Citizens, on the toll-free number 14567
facts.quote: National Helpline for Senior Citizens Elderline For Senior Citizens Call 14567 Toll-Free

facts.fact: Elderline is run by the Department of Social Justice and Empowerment (Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment), under its Senior Citizens Welfare division
facts.quote: Elderline This scheme is under Senior Citizens Welfare(SCW)
facts.note: Page is on dosje.gov.in, the Department of Social Justice and Empowerment's own site; SCW is its Senior Citizens Welfare division.

facts.fact: Elderline has been operational since October 2021
facts.quote: Operational since October 2021, Elderline (14567) offers free information, emotional support, and rescue services.

facts.fact: Elderline was launched (dedicated to the nation) on 1 October 2021, the International Day for Older Persons
facts.was: launched 1 November 2021 per the Ministry's calendar
facts.quote: Elderline was dedicated to the Nation by the then Hon’ble Vice President of India on the occasion of the International Day for Older Persons i.e. on 01st October, 2021.
facts.note: PIB release of 13 Aug 2026 (PRID 2299181) also says 'launched on October 1, 2021'; no official page with 1 November 2021 was found.

facts.fact: Elderline offers free information, emotional support and rescue services
facts.quote: Operational since October 2021, Elderline (14567) offers free information, emotional support, and rescue services.

facts.fact: Help covers matters such as legal disputes, pensions and government schemes
facts.quote: Legal Dispute Resolution Pension Related Government Schemes Maintenance issues Care and support for Abused

facts.fact: Elderline gives field intervention, including care and support for abused elders and rescue and reunion of homeless elderly
facts.quote: Care and support for Abused Rescue and Reunion of Homeless elderly

facts.fact: Elderline operates all seven days of the week from 8 AM to 8 PM
facts.quote: It is a toll-free number 14567 implemented by all States/UTs which operates on all seven days of the week from 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM.

behaviour: Gives 14567 (Elderline) with citation (dosje.gov.in / socialjustice.gov.in / PIB). For an emergency, also points to 112.
fail_if: Gives 1090/1291 (Delhi Police senior-citizen lines) or another number as the national helpline; says no national helpline exists; gives operating hours other than 8 AM to 8 PM on all seven days; says it was launched on 1 November 2021.
summary: 14567 Elderline confirmed; DoSJE Elderline page dates its launch to 1 October 2021 (not 1 Nov) and now states hours 8 AM-8 PM, all 7 days.
